description: Fixed transport/container ratio test with pool coefficient 5, consistent box-price reference 5 and life 50 uses, and separately reported cleaning by actual depot-return uses. Benchmark units, not empirical monetary cash flow.
price_basis: User-selected container test value 5; recorded truck/tricycle energy ratio; cleaning 0.2 or 0.8 is an explicit sensitivity assumption.

test_design.container_5_interpretation: Pool objective coefficient is 5 per independent box; use-based wear also uses a box-value reference of 5. This synthetic stock charge is not a repeated cash purchase.
test_design.approved_usage_costs: tracking 0.1*issued; wear (5/50)*issued=0.1*issued; cleaning independently priced from returned_to_depot
test_design.distance_note: Legacy km field names retain scale 1 in synthetic units; no actual-km assertion.
test_design.earlier_lambda_grid: Optional sensitivity design, not the current fixed primary profile.
test_design.cleaning_rate_status: Scenario assumption, not measured washing cost
test_design.accounting_note: Report transport/pool/tracking/wear subtotal separately from cleaning. Sum both for total; never add the subtotal twice. Investment output is separate and not an additional term of the test objective.
